entries.name: Rite of Swift Shadows
entries.description: Your <hyperlink>Units</hyperlink> immediately regain all of their <movementgeneral></movementgeneral> <hyperlink>Move Points</hyperlink> and gain Universal Camouflage for 2 <turn></turn> <hyperlink>Turns</hyperlink>.

entries.name: Rite of Forbidden Knowledge
entries.description: Instantly gain 400 <knowledge></knowledge> <hyperlink>Knowledge</hyperlink>.

entries.name: Rite of the Exalted
entries.description: All your <hyperlink>Heroes</hyperlink> instantly gain +1 Rank.

entries.name: Rite of the Banners
entries.description: Call a <hyperlink>Rally of the Lieges</hyperlink> event, where you have 20 additional <recruitmentPoints></recruitmentPoints> <hyperlink>Recruitment Points</hyperlink>.

entries.name: Rite of Wealth
entries.description: Instantly gain 2000 <gold></gold> <hyperlink>Gold</hyperlink>.

entries.name: Rite of Allegiance
entries.description: Instantly gain 20 <hyperlink><allegiance></allegiance>Allegiance</hyperlink> with all non-hostile <minorcity></minorcity><hyperlink>Free Cities</hyperlink>.

entries.name: Rite of Conjuration
entries.description: Create a random <hyperlink>Magic Material</hyperlink> near your <hyperlink>Throne City</hyperlink>.

entries.name: Rite of Spell Storm
entries.description: Gain 150 <caststrategic></caststrategic> <hyperlink>World Map Casting Points</hyperlink> and <optactical></optactical> <hyperlink> Combat Casting Points</hyperlink> until the end of the turn.

entries.name: Rite of Astral Abundance
entries.description: Instantly gain 750 <mana></mana> <hyperlink>Mana</hyperlink>.

entries.name: Rite of Stoic Defense
entries.description: All of your current <hyperlink>Units</hyperlink>:<bulletlist><bullet>Heal to their maximum <hyperlink><hp></hp> Hit Points</hyperlink>.</bullet><bullet>Gain +1 <defense></defense> <hyperlink>Defense</hyperlink> and +1 <resistance></resistance> <hyperlink>Resistance</hyperlink>, which does not stack with subsequent uses.</bullet></bulletlist>

entries.name: Rite of Industry
entries.description: All of your <hyperlink>Cities</hyperlink> immediately gain 500 <structureprod></structureprod> <hyperlink>Production</hyperlink>.

entries.name: Rite of the Armorer
entries.description: Immediately gain 500<bindingessence></bindingessence> <hyperlink>Binding Essence</hyperlink> and 250<bindingfragments></bindingfragments> <hyperlink>Binding Fragments</hyperlink>

entries.name: Rite of Fanaticism
entries.description: All of your <hyperlink>Units</hyperlink> gain the following for 5 <turn></turn> <hyperlink>Turns</hyperlink>:<bulletlist><bullet>Resurgence</bullet><bullet>Martyr</bullet></bulletlist>

entries.name: Rite of Chosen Warriors
entries.description:
Your Units all immediately gain enough Experience to level up.



Does not affect Heroes and units above Legendary rank.

entries.name: Rite of War
entries.description: All your <hyperlink>Cities</hyperlink> immediately gain 400<unitprod></unitprod> <hyperlink>Draft</hyperlink>.

entries.name: Rite of Nature's Guardians
entries.description: Immediately summon a <hyperlink>White Wolf</hyperlink> with Resurgence and Animal Guardian and an <hyperlink>Entwined Scourge</hyperlink> with Resurgence and Plant Guardian in your <hyperlink>Throne City</hyperlink>.

entries.name: Rite of Awakening
entries.description: Instantly gain 15<knowledge></knowledge> <hyperlink>Knowledge</hyperlink>, 15<mana></mana> <hyperlink>Mana</hyperlink>, and 15<gold></gold> <hyperlink>Gold</hyperlink> for each <population></population> <hyperlink>Population</hyperlink> in your empire's <hyperlink>Cities</hyperlink>.

entries.name: Rite of Expansive Growth
entries.description: Increase the <hyperlink>City Cap</hyperlink> by +1<citytier></citytier>.

entries.name: Expanded Governance
entries.description: Increase the <hyperlink>City Cap</hyperlink> by +1<citytier></citytier>.

entries.name: Rite of the Last Stand
entries.description: Each city in your Empire loses -1 <population></population> <hyperlink>Population</hyperlink>, but immediately summons 3 <hyperlink>Tier</hyperlink> I <hyperlink>Units</hyperlink>.
